# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤1：清洗公开模拟订单数据 -> clean.csv
规则：
  1) 按 order_id 去重，保留首条
  2) revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单剔除
  3) 不剔除毛利为负的有效订单
数据说明：本数据为【模拟数据】，仅用于流程演示，不代表任何真实公司经营情况。
"""
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import io

# ---------- 读取原始模拟数据 ----------
RAW_CSV = """order_id,month,revenue,cost
A01,2026-01,1200,720
A02,2026-01,800,560
A03,2026-01,1500,900
A03,2026-01,1500,900
B01,2026-02,1800,1200
B02,2026-02,900,720
B03,2026-02,,300
B04,2026-02,1300,780
C01,2026-03,2200,1430
C02,2026-03,1400,980
C03,2026-03,700,770
D01,2026-04,2600,1690
D02,2026-04,1700,1020
D03,2026-04,900,630
D04,2026-04,500,
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV), dtype={'order_id': str, 'month': str})
print("=== 步骤1：清洗【模拟数据】 ===")
print(f"原始记录数: {len(df)}")

# ---------- 检查：重复与缺失 ----------
dup_mask = df.duplicated(subset=['order_id'], keep='first')
dup_count = int(dup_mask.sum())
print(f"重复 order_id 记录数(保留首条后剔除): {dup_count}")

# 缺失检查（revenue / cost）
missing_rev = int(df['revenue'].isna().sum())
missing_cost = int(df['cost'].isna().sum())
missing_any = int((df['revenue'].isna() | df['cost'].isna()).sum())
print(f"revenue 缺失数: {missing_rev}")
print(f"cost 缺失数: {missing_cost}")
print(f"revenue 或 cost 缺失(将被剔除)记录数: {missing_any}")

# ---------- 清洗 ----------
# 1) 去重保留首条
clean = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['order_id'], keep='first').copy()
# 2) 剔除 revenue 或 cost 缺失
clean = clean.dropna(subset=['revenue', 'cost']).copy()
# 3) 类型规整
clean['revenue'] = clean['revenue'].astype(float)
clean['cost'] = clean['cost'].astype(float)
clean = clean.reset_index(drop=True)

# 已知陷阱规避：确认没有负 revenue/cost 造成的异常（此处仅检查并打印，不剔除负毛利订单）
neg_rev = int((clean['revenue'] < 0).sum())
neg_cost = int((clean['cost'] < 0).sum())
neg_gp = int(((clean['revenue'] - clean['cost']) < 0).sum())
print(f"负 revenue 记录数: {neg_rev} | 负 cost 记录数: {neg_cost}")
print(f"毛利为负的有效订单数(按规则保留): {neg_gp}")

print(f"清洗后记录数: {len(clean)}")
print(f"剔除总数: {len(df) - len(clean)} (重复 {dup_count} + 缺失 {missing_any})")

# ---------- 落盘 ----------
clean.to_csv('clean.csv', index=False, encoding='utf-8-sig')
print("已写出: clean.csv")
print(clean.to_string(index=False))

# 中文字体（本机可用 Microsoft YaHei / SimHei）
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

import os
import pandas as pd

# ============================================================
# 本步骤：读取 clean.csv（前序产物），按 month 汇总
# 输出：monthly_summary.csv
# 列名严格为 month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
# 注意：本步骤不重新生成原始数据，仅消费 clean.csv
# ============================================================

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"

# ---------- 1. 输入契约检查：缺失约定输入必须报错 ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤禁止重造数据，请先执行前序清洗步骤。"
    )

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

# ---------- 2. 结构校验（规避已知陷阱） ----------
required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"clean.csv 缺少必要列: {missing_cols}")

# 检查 clean.csv 是否已满足清洗规则（去重 + 无缺失），避免误用未清洗数据
dup_cnt = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
na_cnt = int(clean[["revenue", "cost"]].isna().sum().sum())
print(f"[检查] clean.csv 行数={len(clean)}")
print(f"[检查] 重复 order_id 数={dup_cnt}（应为 0）")
print(f"[检查] revenue/cost 缺失数={na_cnt}（应为 0）")
if dup_cnt != 0 or na_cnt != 0:
    raise ValueError("clean.csv 未满足清洗规则（去重/无缺失），拒绝汇总，请检查前序步骤。")

# 数值化，防止字符串导致的静默错误
clean["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["revenue"], errors="raise")
clean["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["cost"], errors="raise")

# ---------- 3. 按 month 汇总 ----------
# 注意：不剔除毛利为负的有效订单，负毛利需保留并计入
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
)

grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
# 毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入（按定义，非各月毛利率的简单平均）
grp["gross_margin"] = grp["gross_profit"] / grp["revenue"]

# 列顺序严格固定
grp = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]]
grp = grp.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 4. 验证：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计 ----------
sum_rev = float(grp["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost = float(grp["cost"].sum())
sum_profit = float(grp["gross_profit"].sum())
sum_orders = int(grp["orders"].sum())

raw_rev = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
raw_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
raw_profit = raw_rev - raw_cost
raw_orders = int(clean["order_id"].nunique())

print("\n[验证] 按月汇总 vs 清洗明细合计")
print(f"  收入: 汇总={sum_rev:.2f}  明细={raw_rev:.2f}  一致={abs(sum_rev - raw_rev) < 1e-6}")
print(f"  成本: 汇总={sum_cost:.2f}  明细={raw_cost:.2f}  一致={abs(sum_cost - raw_cost) < 1e-6}")
print(f"  毛利: 汇总={sum_profit:.2f}  明细={raw_profit:.2f}  一致={abs(sum_profit - raw_profit) < 1e-6}")
print(f"  订单: 汇总={sum_orders}  明细={raw_orders}  一致={sum_orders == raw_orders}")

# 验证毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入
overall_margin = sum_profit / sum_rev
print(f"[验证] 整体毛利率 = 总毛利/总收入 = {overall_margin:.4f}")

# ---------- 5. 打印汇总结果 ----------
print("\n[结果] 按月汇总（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(grp.to_string(index=False))

# 负毛利月份提示（不剔除，仅标注风险）
neg = grp[grp["gross_profit"] < 0]
if len(neg) > 0:
    print(f"\n[风险] 存在 {len(neg)} 个负毛利月份（已保留，未剔除）:")
    for _, r in neg.iterrows():
        print(f"  {r['month']}: 毛利={r['gross_profit']:.2f} 元, 毛利率={r['gross_margin']:.4f}")
else:
    print("\n[风险] 无负毛利月份。")

# ---------- 6. 落盘 ----------
grp.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[落盘] 已写出 {OUTPUT_FILE}，行数={len(grp)}")

df = df[EXPECTED].copy()
df = df.sort_values('month').reset_index(drop=True)

        label='成本(元)', color='#DD8452')

ax1.set_xticks(list(x))

ax2.set_ylabel('毛利率（%）')
ax2.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)

best = df.loc[df['gross_margin'].idxmax()]

lines.append("## 一、总体经营结果\n")

lines.append(f"- 累计订单数：{total_orders}")
lines.append(f"- 累计收入：{total_rev:,.0f} 元")
lines.append(f"- 累计成本：{total_cost:,.0f} 元")
lines.append(f"- 累计毛利：{total_gp:,.0f} 元")
lines.append(f"- 综合毛利率：{overall_margin*100:.2f}%\n")

lines.append("## 二、分月明细\n")
lines.append("| 月份 | 收入(元) | 成本(元) | 毛利(元) | 毛利率 | 订单数 |")
lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    lines.append(f"| {r['month']} | {r['revenue']:,.0f} | {r['cost']:,.0f} | "
                 f"{r['gross_profit']:,.0f} | {r['gross_margin']*100:.2f}% | "
                 f"{int(r['orders'])} |")
lines.append("")

lines.append("## 三、毛利风险\n")
lines.append(f"- 毛利率最低月份：**{worst['month']}**，毛利率 {worst['gross_margin']*100:.2f}%"

lines.append("- 风险提示：若低毛利/负毛利月份持续，将侵蚀整体盈利，需核查成本上升与折扣策略。\n")

lines.append("## 四、行动建议\n")

lines.append("3. 将高毛利月份的做法（产品结构/客户结构）复制到低毛利月份。")
lines.append("4. 建立月度毛利率预警阈值，低于阈值时触发复盘。\n")

lines.append("---")
lines.append("*数据来源：模拟订单数据（clean.csv → monthly_summary.csv）。"
             "金额单位：元。本报告不构成任何真实经营结论。*")

with open('report.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))
print("[输出] report.md 已生成")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤1：清洗公开模拟订单数据 -> clean.csv
规则：
  1) 按 order_id 去重，保留首条
  2) revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单剔除
  3) 不剔除毛利为负的有效订单
数据说明：本数据为【模拟数据】，仅用于流程演示，不代表任何真实公司经营情况。
"""
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import io

# ---------- 读取原始模拟数据 ----------
RAW_CSV = """order_id,month,revenue,cost
A01,2026-01,1200,720
A02,2026-01,800,560
A03,2026-01,1500,900
A03,2026-01,1500,900
B01,2026-02,1800,1200
B02,2026-02,900,720
B03,2026-02,,300
B04,2026-02,1300,780
C01,2026-03,2200,1430
C02,2026-03,1400,980
C03,2026-03,700,770
D01,2026-04,2600,1690
D02,2026-04,1700,1020
D03,2026-04,900,630
D04,2026-04,500,
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV), dtype={'order_id': str, 'month': str})
print("=== 步骤1：清洗【模拟数据】 ===")
print(f"原始记录数: {len(df)}")

# ---------- 检查：重复与缺失 ----------
dup_mask = df.duplicated(subset=['order_id'], keep='first')
dup_count = int(dup_mask.sum())
print(f"重复 order_id 记录数(保留首条后剔除): {dup_count}")

# 缺失检查（revenue / cost）
missing_rev = int(df['revenue'].isna().sum())
missing_cost = int(df['cost'].isna().sum())
missing_any = int((df['revenue'].isna() | df['cost'].isna()).sum())
print(f"revenue 缺失数: {missing_rev}")
print(f"cost 缺失数: {missing_cost}")
print(f"revenue 或 cost 缺失(将被剔除)记录数: {missing_any}")

# ---------- 清洗 ----------
# 1) 去重保留首条
clean = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['order_id'], keep='first').copy()
# 2) 剔除 revenue 或 cost 缺失
clean = clean.dropna(subset=['revenue', 'cost']).copy()
# 3) 类型规整
clean['revenue'] = clean['revenue'].astype(float)
clean['cost'] = clean['cost'].astype(float)
clean = clean.reset_index(drop=True)

# 已知陷阱规避：确认没有负 revenue/cost 造成的异常（此处仅检查并打印，不剔除负毛利订单）
neg_rev = int((clean['revenue'] < 0).sum())
neg_cost = int((clean['cost'] < 0).sum())
neg_gp = int(((clean['revenue'] - clean['cost']) < 0).sum())
print(f"负 revenue 记录数: {neg_rev} | 负 cost 记录数: {neg_cost}")
print(f"毛利为负的有效订单数(按规则保留): {neg_gp}")

print(f"清洗后记录数: {len(clean)}")
print(f"剔除总数: {len(df) - len(clean)} (重复 {dup_count} + 缺失 {missing_any})")

# ---------- 落盘 ----------
clean.to_csv('clean.csv', index=False, encoding='utf-8-sig')
print("已写出: clean.csv")
print(clean.to_string(index=False))

# 中文字体（本机可用 Microsoft YaHei / SimHei）
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

import os
import pandas as pd

# ============================================================
# 本步骤：读取 clean.csv（前序产物），按 month 汇总
# 输出：monthly_summary.csv
# 列名严格为 month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
# 注意：本步骤不重新生成原始数据，仅消费 clean.csv
# ============================================================

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"

# ---------- 1. 输入契约检查：缺失约定输入必须报错 ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤禁止重造数据，请先执行前序清洗步骤。"
    )

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

# ---------- 2. 结构校验（规避已知陷阱） ----------
required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"clean.csv 缺少必要列: {missing_cols}")

# 检查 clean.csv 是否已满足清洗规则（去重 + 无缺失），避免误用未清洗数据
dup_cnt = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
na_cnt = int(clean[["revenue", "cost"]].isna().sum().sum())
print(f"[检查] clean.csv 行数={len(clean)}")
print(f"[检查] 重复 order_id 数={dup_cnt}（应为 0）")
print(f"[检查] revenue/cost 缺失数={na_cnt}（应为 0）")
if dup_cnt != 0 or na_cnt != 0:
    raise ValueError("clean.csv 未满足清洗规则（去重/无缺失），拒绝汇总，请检查前序步骤。")

# 数值化，防止字符串导致的静默错误
clean["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["revenue"], errors="raise")
clean["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["cost"], errors="raise")

# ---------- 3. 按 month 汇总 ----------
# 注意：不剔除毛利为负的有效订单，负毛利需保留并计入
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
)

grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
# 毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入（按定义，非各月毛利率的简单平均）
grp["gross_margin"] = grp["gross_profit"] / grp["revenue"]

# 列顺序严格固定
grp = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]]
grp = grp.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 4. 验证：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计 ----------
sum_rev = float(grp["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost = float(grp["cost"].sum())
sum_profit = float(grp["gross_profit"].sum())
sum_orders = int(grp["orders"].sum())

raw_rev = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
raw_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
raw_profit = raw_rev - raw_cost
raw_orders = int(clean["order_id"].nunique())

print("\n[验证] 按月汇总 vs 清洗明细合计")
print(f"  收入: 汇总={sum_rev:.2f}  明细={raw_rev:.2f}  一致={abs(sum_rev - raw_rev) < 1e-6}")
print(f"  成本: 汇总={sum_cost:.2f}  明细={raw_cost:.2f}  一致={abs(sum_cost - raw_cost) < 1e-6}")
print(f"  毛利: 汇总={sum_profit:.2f}  明细={raw_profit:.2f}  一致={abs(sum_profit - raw_profit) < 1e-6}")
print(f"  订单: 汇总={sum_orders}  明细={raw_orders}  一致={sum_orders == raw_orders}")

# 验证毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入
overall_margin = sum_profit / sum_rev
print(f"[验证] 整体毛利率 = 总毛利/总收入 = {overall_margin:.4f}")

# ---------- 5. 打印汇总结果 ----------
print("\n[结果] 按月汇总（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(grp.to_string(index=False))

# 负毛利月份提示（不剔除，仅标注风险）
neg = grp[grp["gross_profit"] < 0]
if len(neg) > 0:
    print(f"\n[风险] 存在 {len(neg)} 个负毛利月份（已保留，未剔除）:")
    for _, r in neg.iterrows():
        print(f"  {r['month']}: 毛利={r['gross_profit']:.2f} 元, 毛利率={r['gross_margin']:.4f}")
else:
    print("\n[风险] 无负毛利月份。")

# ---------- 6. 落盘 ----------
grp.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[落盘] 已写出 {OUTPUT_FILE}，行数={len(grp)}")

# 中文字体（本机可用 Microsoft YaHei / SimHei）
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

import os
import pandas as pd

# ============ 输入契约检查 ============
INPUT = 'monthly_summary.csv'
if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"约定输入文件缺失: {INPUT}")

df = pd.read_csv(INPUT)

# 列名严格校验
EXPECTED = ['month', 'revenue', 'cost', 'gross_profit', 'gross_margin', 'orders']
missing_cols = [c for c in EXPECTED if c not in df.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"monthly_summary.csv 缺少列: {missing_cols}")

df = df[EXPECTED].copy()
df = df.sort_values('month').reset_index(drop=True)

# ============ 已知陷阱检查 ============
# 陷阱1: 毛利为负的有效订单不应被剔除，需在报告中体现
neg = df[df['gross_profit'] < 0]
print(f"[检查] 月份数: {len(df)}")
print(f"[检查] 存在毛利为负的月份数: {len(neg)} -> {list(neg['month'])}")
# 陷阱2: gross_margin 与 gross_profit/revenue 一致性
recalc = df['gross_profit'] / df['revenue']
diff = (recalc - df['gross_margin']).abs().max()
print(f"[检查] gross_margin 与重算值最大偏差: {diff:.6f}")
# 陷阱3: 缺失值
print(f"[检查] 缺失值总数: {int(df.isna().sum().sum())}")

# ============ 绘图 ============
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))

x = range(len(df))
ax1.bar([i - 0.2 for i in x], df['revenue'], width=0.4,
        label='收入(元)', color='#4C72B0')
ax1.bar([i + 0.2 for i in x], df['cost'], width=0.4,
        label='成本(元)', color='#DD8452')
ax1.set_ylabel('金额（元）')
ax1.set_xticks(list(x))
ax1.set_xticklabels(df['month'])

ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(list(x), df['gross_margin'] * 100, marker='o', color='#C44E52',
         linewidth=2, label='毛利率(%)')
ax2.set_ylabel('毛利率（%）')
ax2.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)

lines1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

ax1.set_title('月度收入/成本与毛利率趋势（模拟数据，金额单位：元）', fontsize=12)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('figure.svg', format='svg')
plt.close(fig)
print("[输出] figure.svg 已生成")

# ============ 报告 ============
total_rev = df['revenue'].sum()
total_cost = df['cost'].sum()
total_gp = df['gross_profit'].sum()
overall_margin = total_gp / total_rev if total_rev else float('nan')
total_orders = int(df['orders'].sum())

worst = df.loc[df['gross_margin'].idxmin()]
best = df.loc[df['gross_margin'].idxmax()]

lines = []
lines.append("# 月度经营分析报告（管理层版）\n")
lines.append("> **重要声明：本报告全部基于模拟订单数据，非任何公司真实经营结论，"
             "仅用于方法演示。所有金额单位为「元」。**\n")

lines.append("## 一、总体经营结果\n")
lines.append(f"- 覆盖月份数：{len(df)}")
lines.append(f"- 累计订单数：{total_orders}")
lines.append(f"- 累计收入：{total_rev:,.0f} 元")
lines.append(f"- 累计成本：{total_cost:,.0f} 元")
lines.append(f"- 累计毛利：{total_gp:,.0f} 元")
lines.append(f"- 综合毛利率：{overall_margin*100:.2f}%\n")

lines.append("## 二、分月明细\n")
lines.append("| 月份 | 收入(元) | 成本(元) | 毛利(元) | 毛利率 | 订单数 |")
lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    lines.append(f"| {r['month']} | {r['revenue']:,.0f} | {r['cost']:,.0f} | "
                 f"{r['gross_profit']:,.0f} | {r['gross_margin']*100:.2f}% | "
                 f"{int(r['orders'])} |")
lines.append("")

lines.append("## 三、毛利风险\n")
lines.append(f"- 毛利率最低月份：**{worst['month']}**，毛利率 {worst['gross_margin']*100:.2f}%"
             f"（毛利 {worst['gross_profit']:,.0f} 元）。")
if len(neg) > 0:
    lines.append(f"- 存在 **{len(neg)}** 个毛利为负的月份：{', '.join(neg['month'])}，"
                 "属于有效订单但亏损，需重点关注定价与成本结构。")
else:
    lines.append("- 各月毛利均为正，无亏损月份。")
lines.append(f"- 毛利率最高月份：{best['month']}，毛利率 {best['gross_margin']*100:.2f}%。")
lines.append("- 风险提示：若低毛利/负毛利月份持续，将侵蚀整体盈利，需核查成本上升与折扣策略。\n")

lines.append("## 四、行动建议\n")
lines.append("1. 对毛利为负或偏低的月份进行成本拆解，定位成本异常项。")
lines.append("2. 复核定价与折扣政策，避免以低于成本的价格成交。")
lines.append("3. 将高毛利月份的做法（产品结构/客户结构）复制到低毛利月份。")
lines.append("4. 建立月度毛利率预警阈值，低于阈值时触发复盘。\n")

lines.append("---")
lines.append("*数据来源：模拟订单数据（clean.csv → monthly_summary.csv）。"
             "金额单位：元。本报告不构成任何真实经营结论。*")

with open('report.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))
print("[输出] report.md 已生成")

# ============ 落盘校验 ============
for p in ['figure.svg', 'report.md']:
    print(f"[校验] {p} 存在: {os.path.exists(p)}, 大小: {os.path.getsize(p)} bytes")
